product.eventDescription: One Amazon product from a search or Best Sellers / New Releases list: ASIN, title, price, list price, rating, review count, bought in past month, badges, sponsored and Prime flags, rank for lists, image and URL. A search with no results is free.

product_detail.eventDescription: The same product plus its product page: brand, bullet points, specs and details table, Best Sellers Rank, categories, availability, seller and ships-from, all images, variations and description. Only with Full product page on, or for ASINs and product URLs; charged instead of Product, not on top of it.
